source: Zhang et al. (2024), results of RQ1.xlsx
snippet: whole function main, lines 46 to 142 of the original
external_dependencies: sqlite3 (standard library), real; the database card.s3db is created in the temporary folder of the test
removed_from_original: lines 1 and 2, comments '# Write your code here' and '# Create a simple banking system' (exercise statement).
scaffolding: class Bank and check_luhn copied from the original, with their comments.
run(): calls main(); the __main__ guard calls run().

side_effects.description: The snippet reads with input() without text, writes to card.s3db in the current folder and exits with exit().
side_effects.handling: The test uses a temporary folder (monkeypatch.chdir), replaces input() with a double and random.randint (used by the Bank of the scaffolding) with a fixed sequence, and expects SystemExit.

pinned_behavior: typical: creates an account, logs in, balance 0, deposits 100, balance 100, logs out of the account and exits the program: exact text of the menus and the final record in the database.

edge: two accounts; transfer to a card with a wrong Luhn digit, to a nonexistent card, above the balance and a correct one; closing of the account; login to a closed account and a wrong PIN refused; final state of the database.
invalid: a non-numeric menu option raises ValueError, without storing an account.
not_pinned_on_purpose: The SQLite connection is never closed by the original; the test does not pin this.

adaptation_check.snippet_diff: identical to the original (lines 46 to 142 against 50 to 146 of the unit)
